title: Find the ID of the earliest-admitted female patient diagnosed with SLE who
question: Find the ID of the earliest-admitted female patient diagnosed with SLE who had abnormal alkaliphosphatase (ALP ≥ 300) and exhibited proteinuria within the normal range (0 < U-PRO < 30). Among such patients, also ensure they underwent laboratory testing between 1995 and 1998 to increase data coverage.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND T2."XCL_048" >= 300
  AND T2."XCL_045" > '0'
  AND T2."XCL_045" < '30'
  AND T2."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
ORDER BY T1."XCL_062" ASC
LIMIT 1
